text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Heavy fighting in Freetown as West African force ECOMOG bombardcountability.
- State oil company maintains silence as fuel scarcity bites harder.
- George Akamiokhor, director general of Securities and Exchange Commission, the regulatory body for the capital market, retires after 37 years in service.
- Federal government assures World Bank that it is determined to privatise state enterprises and to merge the dual exchange rate before end of year, says a visiting bank official.

- Special duties minister Wada Nas accuses pro-democracy groups of planning violence under guise of marking first year anniversary of the death of Kudirat Abiola, senior wife of detained presidential claimant Moshood Abiola.
